name: Curation becomes authorship and website
statement: Users can accomplish curation becomes authorship and website while preserving user-owned meaning, usability and consent.
requiredProperties: Manual editable title independent of original filename and source title
Reuse existing notes, images, galleries and tags as titled photo essays, gallery websites, articles and portfolios
Choose which bookmarks to include and put links after relevant prose, inline or as bibliography
Publication ordered blocks with independent editorial text and source references
Linked or pinned snapshot variants; publishing never mutates original annotations
Accessible safe static HTML/CSS/JS output for generic host including GitHub Pages/Cloudflare Pages
Future templates for timelines, research exhibits, charts and interactive public graph views
